==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=OpenTelemetry&min=OpenTelemetry&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/OpenTelemetryTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=OpenTelemetry&min=OpenTelemetry&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Diagnostics;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using OpenTelemetry;
using OpenTelemetry.Logs;

// Verify.OpenTelemetry: Records Activity spans through a process-wide listener, and snapshots them and OpenTelemetry LogRecords.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.OpenTelemetry
// Note: The ActivityListener is process wide and listens to every ActivitySource, so a parallel
// test can capture activities another test started.
// Note: Activities land in the shared recording under activity; other recording plugins add their
// own entries to the same snapshot.
// Note: Kept for an activity: operation name, display name when it differs, kind when it is not
// Internal, status, tags, events, links and baggage.
// Note: Kept for a LogRecord: category name, level, body, formatted message, a non-default event
// id, the exception and the attributes.
// Note: Initialize() has to run before the first verification; it throws otherwise.
// Note: The package targets net10.0 only.
public class OpenTelemetryTests
{
    // Every activity that stops between Recording.Start() and the verification is added to the
    // snapshot under the name activity, keyed by its operation name.
    // Ids, timestamps and durations are left out, because they change on every run.
    [Fact]
    public Task Activity()
    {
        Recording.Start();
        using var source = new ActivitySource("TestSource");

        using (var activity = source.StartActivity("MyOperation"))
        {
            activity!.SetTag("key1", "value1");
            activity.SetTag("key2", 42);
        }

        return Verify("result");
    }
}
